notes.title: DION Playtest 8#– Starts Now!
notes.notes:
🔥 DION Playtest 8🔥

📅 When:
🕗 Starts: Tuesday, May 20 at 8:00 AM (local time)
🕛 Ends: Sunday, May 25 at 11:59 PM (local time)

🎮 How to join:
1️⃣ Visit the DION Steam page
2️⃣ Click "Request Access" to join the playtest

✅ Be among the first to explore new content
✅ Help improve the game with your feedback
✅ Enjoy an early look before the official release

💬 Join the community:
🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/c9N6bRcZP3
📢 Chat, report bugs, and connect with other players in real-time!

🚀 Let’s build DION together — see you in-game! 🚀
